title: Tire-Care Points on Out-of-Area Replacement Reimbursements
content:
Under Road Hazard Protection, a covered set kept on Crestline's rotation schedule earns tire-care points on the reimbursement of an out-of-area tire replacement. The rotations counted are the Crestline rotation services on the covered set's Tire Sets & Treadwear Limited Warranty history.

**Out-of-area tire-care points.** A covered set with two or more Crestline rotation services in the last 12 whole calendar months and its most recent rotation fewer than 6 whole months ago adds 3 points to the out-of-area coverage percentage; a set with at least one rotation in that period that has fewer than two of them or whose most recent rotation is 6 or more whole months ago adds 1 point; a set with no rotation in that period adds no out-of-area tire-care points.

| Rotations in the last 12 whole months | Most recent rotation | Points |
|---|---|---|
| two or more | fewer than 6 whole months ago | 3 |
| two or more | 6 or more whole months ago | 1 |
| exactly one | any | 1 |
| none | — | 0 |

*Boundary (hypothetical).* Two rotations, the latest 5 whole months ago: 3 points; the same two with the latest exactly 6 whole months ago: 1 point.
